confess_seo_1.name: {name}
confess_seo_1.text: *The date is over. Instead of heading for the front gate, we go up to the rooftop.*

confess_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_2.text: Let's go up for a minute.

confess_seo_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_3.text: *The rooftop. The field lights glow below the railing. It's the spot where Seoyeon stood on my first day.*

confess_seo_3b.name: {name}
confess_seo_3b.text: *The rooftop. The field lights glow below the railing. We've come up here several times in just a few days.*

confess_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_4.text: *Seoyeon stands one step back from the railing and slips the key into her pocket.*

confess_seo_4_b.name: {name}
confess_seo_4_b.text: *My fingers catch on the folded note inside my pocket.*

confess_seo_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_2.text: *My throat is dry. The note folds inside my pocket.*

confess_seo_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_3.text: I want to keep seeing you after today.

confess_seo_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_4.text: *Seoyeon doesn't answer right away. The key ring turns once in her hand.*

confess_seo_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_5.text: You don't have to answer right now.

confess_seo_yes_6.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_6.text: Saying that only makes me think about it more.

confess_seo_yes_9.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_9.text: Where you sit. When you get quiet.

confess_seo_yes_11.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_11.text: I'll leave the rooftop open tomorrow at lunch.

confess_seo_yes_12.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_12.text: *She goes down two steps and stops without looking back.*

confess_seo_no_1.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_1.text: Want to stay a little longer?

confess_seo_no_3.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_no_3.text: *We both look down at the field. Another light switches on.*

confess_seo_no_4.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_no_4.text: Come by tomorrow at lunch if you have time.

confess_seo_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_4_b.text: *The note stays in my pocket all the way down the stairs.*

confess_yuna_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_1.text: *The date is winding down. Yuna stops walking.*

confess_yuna_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3.text: *Library annex. The secret reading spot. Sunset seeps through the window. Yuna's bookmark rests beside the old sofa.*

confess_yuna_3b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3b.text: *The library annex. Sunset seeps through the window. A bookmark rests beside the sofa.*

confess_yuna_4.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_4.text: *She sits on the sofa and looks at {name}, a bookmark held in one hand.*

confess_yuna_5.name: {name}
confess_yuna_5.text: *The tip of the bookmark is bent.*

confess_yuna_choice.name: {name}
choices: Yuna. Let me ask you one thing.

confess_yuna_yes_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_1.text: *My voice comes out smaller than I expected.*

confess_yuna_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3.text: Yuna. When I'm with you, I don't have to choose my words as carefully.

confess_yuna_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_5.text: I want to keep seeing you after today.

confess_yuna_yes_6.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_6.text: You don't have to answer right now.

confess_yuna_yes_6_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_6_b.text: *When I finish speaking, the sound of turning pages is gone.*

confess_yuna_yes_8.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_8.text: *She cannot look toward {name} and grips her sleeve tightly.*

confess_yuna_yes_8_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_8_b.text: *The crumpled ends of the sleeves disappear into the palm.*

confess_yuna_yes_8_c.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_8_c.text: ...Tell me first. If you're going to disappear.

confess_yuna_yes_9_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_9_b.text: *Yuna keeps hold of the end of her sleeve.*

confess_yuna_no_2.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_no_2.text: *She nods. She slips the bookmark between the pages, then pushes it in deeper.*

confess_yuna_no_3.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_no_3.text: *She picks up a book. She's looking at the cover, but she's not reading.*

confess_yuna_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_4_b.text: *Three steps away, I looked back. Yuna was watching me too, over the top of her book.*

confess_dain_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_1.text: *The date is winding down. Dain runs toward the school.*

confess_dain_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_3.text: *The gym. Empty. Sunset stains the court through the windows. The line from our first-day bet is still visible.*

confess_dain_3b.name: {name}
confess_dain_3b.text: *The gym is empty. Sunset spills through the windows and colors the court.*

confess_dain_4.name: Dain
confess_dain_4.text: *She is holding a ball. Casually. — But her fingers are white. She's gripping it tight.*

confess_dain_5.name: {name}
confess_dain_5.text: *The ball bounces once against the floor.*

confess_dain_choice.name: Dain
confess_dain_choice.text: *Her ball bounces once. The hand that would've caught it normally stops in midair a beat too late.*

confess_dain_yes_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_1.text: *My voice settles low against the gym floor.*

confess_dain_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_2.text: *I steady one short breath and open my mouth again.*

confess_dain_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3.text: Dain. There's — something I need to tell you.

confess_dain_yes_3_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3_b.text: I want to keep seeing you after today.

confess_dain_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_5.text: You don't have to answer right now.

confess_dain_yes_6.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_6.text: I just wanted you to know.

confess_dain_yes_8.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_8.text: *Dain freezes where she stands and covers her face with both hands.*

confess_dain_yes_8_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_8_b.text: *She keeps her face covered. The volleyball bumps her toes, but she doesn't pick it up.*

confess_dain_yes_9.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_9.text: ...Wait. I can't get my words straight right now.

confess_dain_yes_9_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_9_b.text: *She lowers her hands and smiles, roughly wiping her eyes with her sleeve.*

confess_dain_yes_10_b.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_10_b.text: *She hugs the ball again. The backs of her hands tense.*

confess_dain_no_2.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_2.text: *I toss the ball up for her. No words come out.*

confess_dain_no_3.name: Dain
confess_dain_no_3.text: *She bounces a volleyball. Once. Twice. — On the third bounce, she stops.*

confess_dain_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_b.text: *No exclamation mark. Dain adjusts her wrist guard.*
